qualifier: activation by BH3-only proteins PUMA, NOXA and BAD
name: BH3-only protein activation of BAX/BAK cytochrome c release
rationale: All members describe BH3-only proteins (PUMA, NOXA, BAD) neutralising anti-apoptotic BCL-2 members and activating BAX/BAK to release cytochrome c, whereas confusables centre on MOMP regulation in general, p53 transcription, or downstream apoptosome/SMAC events.

name: Hypoxia-inducible factor signaling and glycolytic flux control
rationale: Members combine HIF oxygen sensing and hypoxia responses with glycolysis, fructose-bisphosphate regulation, lactate production and p53/mTORC1 metabolic control, distinguishing it from FOXO/AKT, NRF2 and plain glucose-catabolism confusables.

core: JNK and p38 stress-activated kinase regulation
name: TAK1-mediated JNK and p38 stress kinase regulation
rationale: All members concern positive or negative control of the JNK and p38 stress-activated MAPK cascades including TAK1-driven activation, unlike confusables about NOD signaling, AP-1 transcription or ERK feedback.

core: Ubiquitin-dependent receptor endocytosis and lysosomal downregulation
name: Ubiquitin-mediated endocytic downregulation of EGFR/ERBB receptors
rationale: Members cover ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis and MVB sorting of activated receptors, especially EGFR/ERBB2-4 downregulation, distinguishing it from ESCRT machinery, PTEN/AKT and MET signaling confusables.

name: NOD1/NOD2 receptor signaling regulation
rationale: All three members are NOD1, NOD2 or NLR signaling pathway terms, without the peptidoglycan response, inflammasome, NF-kB or cytokine terms of the confusables.

name: Trans-synaptic adhesion-driven synapse assembly and excitatory receptor clustering
rationale: Members cover neurexin/neuroligin, SALM and RPTP adhesion organising pre- and postsynaptic assembly with PSD-95/NMDA receptor clustering and EPSP control, whereas confusables emphasise inhibitory GABA receptor clustering or generic neuronal adhesion.

name: Osteoclast differentiation, fusion and bone resorption regulation
rationale: All members concern osteoclast development, proliferation, fusion and bone resorption/remodeling, distinguishing it from macrophage CSF1 signaling, osteoblast and macrophage fusion confusables.

name: Polyol pathway alditol and fructose metabolism
rationale: Members are alditol synthesis, alditol breakdown and fructose metabolism, the polyol route, unlike confusables on fructose catabolism disorders, pentose phosphate, glycerolipid or xylulose metabolism.

name: CCT/TRiC chaperonin folding of nascent actin and tubulin
rationale: All members describe CCT/TRiC binding and folding of newly synthesised proteins, notably actin and tubulin, distinguishing it from aggrephagy, general refolding and ER folding confusables.

qualifier: GLUT4 translocation and insulin receptor recycling
name: Insulin-stimulated GLUT4 translocation, glucose uptake and receptor recycling
rationale: Members cover insulin-driven GLUT4 trafficking (including RHOQ/TC10), glucose import, insulin receptor recycling and insulin clearance, while confusables add adiponectin signaling, fatty acid handling or IRS/AKT signal attenuation.

core: Regulation of T cell activation and tolerance
qualifier: dendritic cell costimulation, anergy and regulatory T cell induction
name: T cell activation versus tolerance via dendritic cell costimulation
rationale: Members span dendritic cell differentiation and costimulation, T cell activation, anergy, tolerance and Treg differentiation with suppression of Th1/Th17 cytokines, whereas confusables focus on tumor immunity, Th1 differentiation or NK cytotoxicity.

name: Forebrain interneuron tangential migration and cortical regionalization
rationale: Members are GABAergic interneuron and olfactory bulb precursor tangential migration plus cortex regionalization, distinguishing it from radial glia-guided migration, layer formation and cerebellar development confusables.

name: BDNF, NT-3 and NT-4 signaling via TRKB and TRKC
rationale: Members cover BDNF/NT-3/NT-4 activation of TRKB and TRKC and their downstream RAS, PI3K, PLCG1, ERK5, p38 and CREB effectors, while confusables centre on NGF/TRKA, retrograde signaling or p75NTR.

name: Restraint of type 2 cytokine and IgE production
rationale: Members concern suppression of IL-4, IL-5, IL-13 and immunoglobulin production, IgE switching and mast cell cytokines, whereas confusables promote Th2 differentiation, eosinophil biology or IL-4/IL-13/IL-33 signaling.

qualifier: lysosomal fusion of autophagosomes and late endosomes
name: Autophagosome formation, maturation and lysosomal fusion
rationale: Members regulate autophagosome assembly and maturation and fusion of autophagosomes, late endosomes and MVBs with lysosomes, distinguishing it from selective autophagy (mitophagy, pexophagy) and phagosome fusion confusables.

name: Ceramide and sphingomyelin metabolism and sphingolipid homeostasis
rationale: Members cover de novo sphingoid/ceramide and sphingomyelin synthesis, its regulation and catabolism, distinguishing it from lipid transfer, glycosphingolipid and ceramide-signaling confusables.

core: Endosomal recycling and Golgi vesicle trafficking
name: ARF/Rab GTPase-regulated endosome recycling and Golgi vesicle budding
rationale: Members combine ARF and Rab/TBC GAP signaling with endosomal tubulation and receptor recycling and Golgi budding/constitutive secretion, unlike confusables on COPII/flippase traffic or Golgi positioning.

name: Synaptic calcium and cAMP kinase signaling to CREB
rationale: Members describe CaMKII/CaMKK/CaMKIV, CaMKK-AMPK and adenylate cyclase/PKA cascades driven by synaptic activity converging on CREB, distinguishing it from MECP2, NPAS4/memory and dopamine-receptor cAMP confusables.

core: Early embryonic axis and neural plate morphogenesis
qualifier: Hedgehog and planar cell polarity signaling
name: Hedgehog and planar polarity signaling in early axis morphogenesis
rationale: Members combine Hedgehog/GLI signaling and PCP/convergent extension with neural plate, floor plate, notochord and axial mesoderm development, whereas confusables involve Wnt-calcium, Nodal left-right asymmetry or neural plate border/HOX patterning.

qualifier: optic cup, retina and optic nerve morphogenesis
name: Eye morphogenesis of optic cup, retina and optic nerve
rationale: Members cover optic cup, retina layering and cell differentiation, iris, eyelid, pigmentation and optic nerve/RGC axon formation, distinguishing it from lens/cornea, photoreceptor maturation and inner ear confusables.

qualifier: multivesicular body, exosome and viral budding
name: ESCRT membrane scission for multivesicular bodies, exosomes, viral budding
rationale: All members involve ESCRT machinery budding membranes away from the cytosol, in MVB formation, exosome release, HIV/viral budding and nuclear envelope sealing, unlike autophagy, ubiquitin endocytosis or cytokinesis confusables.

name: Hippo signaling and cell density sensing
rationale: Members are Hippo pathway signaling and its regulation plus detection of cell density, while confusables are adherens junction, apical polarity and EMT terms.

qualifier: PSD maintenance, receptor delivery and local translation
name: Postsynaptic structure maintenance and long-term structural plasticity
rationale: Members cover PSD maintenance, postsynaptic actin, receptor delivery, local translation and long-term structural plasticity, distinguishing it from dendrite arborization, spine and filopodium morphogenesis confusables.

core: Replication stress and genotoxic drug response
name: Poly-ADP-ribosylation and fork reversal in replication stress response
rationale: Members combine protein (de/poly/auto) ADP-ribosylation, fork reversal, DNA topology, protein-DNA crosslink and R-loop repair, and responses to hydroxyurea, camptothecin, cisplatin and bleomycin, unlike the double-strand break and homologous recombination repair confusables.

qualifier: tryptophan-kynurenine de novo synthesis and nicotinate salvage, with energy-redox balance
name: Tryptophan-kynurenine and nicotinate NAD+ synthesis with energy-redox homeostasis
rationale: Members span kynurenine-route and salvage NAD+/NADP+ synthesis, NAD and mitochondrial ATP/ADP transport, phosphocreatine and redox state, distinguishing it from coenzyme A, pyruvate dehydrogenase, polyamine and creatine confusables.
